# Fun Hub

> Five free two-player games that run in a mobile browser. Two people each use
> their own phone in the same room, paired by scanning a QR code. No app
> install, no account, no signup, no advertising. The two phones exchange game
> data directly over the local WiFi using a WebRTC data channel, so no game
> data passes through a server.

Requirements: two phones on the same WiFi network, each with a modern browser
that supports WebRTC data channels (Safari on iOS, Chrome on Android, Edge,
Brave, Samsung Internet). Mobile data does not work for pairing. Public and
guest WiFi with client isolation enabled will block pairing.

## Games

- [Air Hockey](https://funhub.super-dar.com/airhockey/): Real time. 2 players,
  ~3 min. Drag your thumb across your own half to slide your mallet. Each phone
  shows the table from its own end. First to 7 goals wins. Practice bot available.
- [Chess](https://funhub.super-dar.com/chess/): Turn based. 1-2 players, ~10 min.
  Full rules including castling, en passant, promotion and threefold repetition.
  Five minutes each with a three second increment. Single-player computer
  opponent at easy, normal or hard.
- [Dawn Patrol](https://funhub.super-dar.com/dawnpatrol/): Real time. 2 players,
  ~3 min. Dogfight. Drag to bank, hold FIRE until the guns overheat. Parachuted
  crates boost rate of fire, damage and gun count. First to 5 kills wins.
- [Moonbloom](https://funhub.super-dar.com/moonbloom/): Real time. 2 players,
  ~2 min. Lead a moth with a fingertip and hold it over a closed bud to open it
  in your colour. Blooms cannot be taken back. First to 8 blossoms wins.
- [Orchard](https://funhub.super-dar.com/orchard/): Real time. 2 players, ~3 min.
  Snake in a wrapping orchard. Swipe to steer, hold to sprint. Fruit lengthens
  you, bombs cost 100 points, ramming the other snake scores. First to 5 hits wins.

## Privacy

No accounts, no tracking cookies, no gameplay analytics, no server-side record
of any match. Scores exist only in the two browsers until the tab closes.
